name: texture-card

frames.best_why: The full card is visible with no cursor over the title, body or footer.

tagline: Dark card edged with stacked border rings and a faint surface texture.
summary: A content card built from several inset border rings that give it a soft stacked edge instead of a heavy shadow, with header, body and footer slots.
appearance: A wide dark card with a rounded edge made of several thin nested rings. White title and grey copy sit in three bands split by hairlines, with a small footer label and link.
demo_content: Headline Surface Texture, two filler paragraphs, footer label cult/ui and an Explore link.
search_phrases: content card with soft inset edges
dark card for a description and link
tactile card without a drop shadow
simple info card with header and footer
card that works in light and dark mode
panel with a subtle framed edge
use_when: You want a card edge with depth and no heavy shadow, and need header, body and footer slots.
avoid_when: Content is interactive or needs strong hierarchy; the faint rings and low-contrast text stay quiet.
customise: Header, title, description, content, footer and separator pieces compose the card and take class names; radius, rings and colours live in the source.
weight_why: Pure markup made of borders; no script or animation.

a11y.note: Nothing to operate; the heading is a real h3, but the footer Explore label is a plain span, not a link.

issues: The footer Explore label looks like a link but is a non-interactive span.
polish_why: Tidy three-band layout and a ring edge; otherwise an ordinary card with faint contrast.
title: Texture Card
